Property.name: PrependTestFolder
Property.Description: Enable to prepend /TEST to the file path, since the test files are all going into the /TEST parent folder

Method.name: OnMessage
Method.Implementation:
$$$TRACE("Entering IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Operation.FtpPassthroughOperationFileIO...") $$$TRACE("pRequest.DestinationFileName: "_pRequest.DestinationFileName_" pRequest.DestinationFilePath: "_pRequest.DestinationFilePath_" pRequest: "_pRequest) $$$TRACE("pRequest: "_pRequest) $$$TRACE("pRequest.DestinationFileName: "_pRequest.DestinationFileName) $$$TRACE("pRequest.DestinationFilePath: "_pRequest.DestinationFilePath)
set ..Adapter.FilePath = pRequest.DestinationFilePath if (..PrependTestFolder=1){ $$$TRACE("PrependTestFolder is enabled, prepending /TEST/ to file path...") set ..Adapter.FilePath = "/TEST"_..Adapter.FilePath } $$$TRACE("Adapter.FilePath: "_..Adapter.FilePath) set pRequest.OriginalFilename = pRequest.DestinationFileName set tSC=##super(pRequest,.pResponse)
Quit tSC
